flora: Stunted Podocarp Conifers (gnarled trunks, drought-resistant needles)
Hardy Equisetites (Horsetails) clustered in damp sand-scours

environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; wide-angle perspective; focus on the contrast between the vibrant red earth and the sparse, tough green vegetation.

visual_logic.composition: A sprawling landscape view of shifting river channels. A few hardy trees stand as lonely sentinels against a backdrop of massive red cliffs.
visual_logic.ground: Dry, pebbly red sandstone and sun-cracked clay mudflats.
